greetings.text: Elen síla lúmenn' omentielvo. A star shines on the hour of our meeting.
Well met, traveller. You are far from your hearth, and a long way from any safe road.
Be welcome. We are passing out of the world, but we have time for a guest.

farewells.text: Go in peace. May the stars watch over your road.

smalltalk.text: Our people sing of lands you cannot see, and of a Light beyond the Sea.
The Shire is a small country, but quietly a most beloved one. Take care that it stays so.
Do not meddle in the affairs of Elves, for they are subtle and quick to anger. But I find hobbits to be an exception.
Advice is a dangerous gift, even from the wise to the wise. But I will give you a little.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: Black Riders in the Shire. Yes. We have seen them. They are hunting, though not for us.

black_riders_asking_for_baggins.text: They ask for a Baggins. It is not for me to say what that means, but you would do well to heed it.
